subUsers.heading: Sub-users
subUsers.subtitle: People you give access to this account, each signing in with their own password and reaching only the features you choose.
subUsers.emptyDescription: Invite the first person above. They receive an e-mail and choose their own password.
subUsers.noResultsDescription: Change the search, or clear it to see everyone.
subUsers.invited: Invitation requested for {name}. The person appears in the list below once it has been created.

form.heading: Invite a person
form.hint: They get an e-mail with a one-time link to choose their own password. You never see it.

errors.usernameInvalid: Use letters, digits, dots, underscores and dashes, up to 64 characters.

featuresDialog.title: Features of {name}
featuresDialog.description: The person can use exactly the ticked features, and only those the account's plan includes. A change applies from their next request.

remove.title: Remove {name}
remove.question: Remove this person? Their access ends immediately and their login is deleted if it was made only for this account.

subUsers.offered: If that login exists, an offer was sent. The person has to accept it before they join.

resend.sent: A new invitation was sent to {name}. The earlier link no longer works.

cancelOffer.title: Cancel the offer to {name}
cancelOffer.question: Cancel this offer? The person will no longer be able to accept it. Nothing changes for their login.

existing.heading: Add an existing login
existing.hint: The person is asked to accept inside the panel the next time they sign in. They are added only if they do, and you never learn whether the login exists.

errors.identifierRequired: Enter a login name or an e-mail address.
errors.identifierTooLong: That is too long for a login name or an e-mail address.
